effects: The signer sends `amount` of the vault collateral (0xA9402c88…, BaseTHQInternal) to the vault through transferFrom, which uses up that much of the signer's allowance to the vault.
Active vault shares, worth what actually arrived (measured as a balance difference), are credited to `onBehalfOf`, not to the signer unless they are the same address.
No native value is taken: the function is not payable.
formats.shown: Deposit a stated amount of BaseTHQInternal into the named vault, with the shares credited to the stated beneficiary.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted depends on the vault's stake and share totals in storage and is not shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_);` These totals are read from storage, and no field shows the shares.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. The beneficiary and the amount of collateral are shown, and that is enough.

effects: The vault burns enough of the signer's active shares to cover `amount` of collateral (previewWithdraw, rounded up).
`amount` of collateral is queued for withdrawal in the next epoch, and the right to claim it goes to `claimer`, who may be someone other than the signer.
No tokens move in this call. The queued amount can still be slashed until it is claimed, and it can only be claimed after the epoch ends.
formats.shown: Request a withdrawal of a stated amount of BaseTHQInternal, with the stated address as the claim owner.

findings.title: withdraw: the shares burned and the later slashing exposure come from storage and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake());` In onSlash, `withdrawals[currentEpoch_ + 1] = nextWithdrawals - nextWithdrawalsSlashed;` can cut the queued amount.
findings.fix: None needed beyond the current fields. Optionally, word the intent as 'Request withdrawal (claimable next epoch)'.

effects: `shares` of the signer's active vault shares are burned.
Collateral worth those shares (previewRedeem, rounded down) is queued for the next epoch, and the right to claim it goes to `claimer`.
No tokens move in this call. The queued collateral can still be slashed before it is claimed.
formats.shown: Queue a raw number of vault shares for withdrawal, with the stated address as the claim owner.

findings.title: redeem: the share amount is shown as a raw integer, although shares use the collateral's 18 decimals.
findings.evidence: In descriptor `#.shares` the format is "raw" and the label is 'Vault shares (raw)'. Case 2 shows '987654321123456789'. ERC4626Math `_decimalsOffset()` returns 0, so shares are on the same scale as the 18-decimal collateral (case 0: 0x6ae6ff5fe56e50000 = 123.25).
findings.fix: Use the `unit` format with `decimals: 18` and `base: "shares"` (or a similar label), so the signer sees about 0.9877 shares instead of an 18-digit integer.

findings.title: redeem: the collateral queued for these shares depends on the exchange rate in storage and is not shown.

effects: The signer's withdrawal for `epoch` is marked as claimed, which uses up their claim right for that epoch.
The signer's full claimable amount for that epoch (withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender)) is sent in collateral (BaseTHQInternal) from the vault to `recipient`, who may be someone other than the signer.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawal for a numbered epoch and send it to the stated recipient. Neither the token nor the amount is named.

findings.title: claim: the amount paid comes from storage, and the screen never names the token.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol _claim: `amount = withdrawalsOf(epoch, msg.sender);` then claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);` The descriptor's intent 'Claim withdrawal' and its fields (Vault, Epoch, Recipient) do not mention BaseTHQInternal.
findings.fix: The amount cannot be shown. Name the asset in the intent, for example 'Claim BaseTHQInternal withdrawal'.

effects: Every listed epoch is marked as claimed for the signer, which uses up those claim rights.
The sum of the signer's claimable amounts across those epochs is sent in collateral (BaseTHQInternal) from the vault to `recipient` in one transfer.
formats.shown: Claim the withdrawals for the listed epochs and send them to the stated recipient. Neither the token nor the amount is named.

findings.title: claimBatch: the total paid comes from storage, and the screen never names the token.
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `amount += _claim(epochs[i]);` then `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);` The descriptor's intent 'Claim withdrawals' does not name the asset.
findings.fix: The amount cannot be shown. Name the asset in the intent, for example 'Claim BaseTHQInternal withdrawals'.

redeem(address claimer,uint256 shares).worst: redeem: the share amount is shown as a raw integer, although shares use the collateral's 18 decimals.
